examples.english: The peace talks collapsed into a political quagmire with no clear way forward.
examples.persian: مذاکرات صلح به یک وضعیت بسیار پیچیده و دشوار سیاسی تبدیل شد که راه پیش روی مشخصی نداشت.

miniContext: The peace talks collapsed into a political quagmire with no clear way forward.

examples.english: The captain's calm voice helped quell the passengers' panic during the turbulence.
examples.persian: صدای آرام کاپیتان به سرکوب و آرام کردن وحشت مسافران در هنگام تکان‌های هوایی کمک کرد.

miniContext: The captain's calm voice helped quell the passengers' panic during the turbulence.

examples.english: The querulous neighbor complained about the noise, the parking, and the weather almost daily.
examples.persian: همسایه شاکی و غرغرو تقریباً هر روز از سروصدا، پارکینگ و آب‌وهوا گله می‌کرد.

miniContext: The querulous neighbor complained about the noise, the parking, and the weather almost daily.

examples.english: With its red phone booths and rainy streets, London felt like the quintessential English city.
examples.persian: با باجه‌های تلفن قرمز و خیابان‌های بارانی‌اش، لندن مانند نمونه کامل و برجسته یک شهر انگلیسی به نظر می‌رسید.

miniContext: With its red phone booths and rainy streets, London felt like the quintessential English city.

examples.english: The recalcitrant toddler refused to put on his shoes no matter what anyone tried.
examples.persian: آن کودک سرکش و سازش‌ناپذیر حاضر نشد کفش‌هایش را بپوشد، هرچه که دیگران تلاش کردند.

miniContext: The recalcitrant toddler refused to put on his shoes no matter what anyone tried.

examples.english: After the fame of her first book, the reclusive author moved to a cabin with no phone.
examples.persian: پس از شهرت کتاب اولش، آن نویسنده گوشه‌گیر به کلبه‌ای بدون تلفن نقل مکان کرد.

miniContext: After the fame of her first book, the reclusive author moved to a cabin with no phone.

examples.english: The young swimmer had to face a redoubtable champion who had never lost a race.
examples.persian: آن شناگر جوان باید با قهرمانی ترسناک و قابل احترام روبه‌رو می‌شد که هرگز در هیچ مسابقه‌ای نباخته بود.

miniContext: The young swimmer had to face a redoubtable champion who had never lost a race.

examples.english: The refractory patient refused every treatment the doctors suggested.
examples.persian: آن بیمار سرکش و رام‌نشدنی هر درمانی را که پزشکان پیشنهاد می‌دادند، رد می‌کرد.

miniContext: The refractory patient refused every treatment the doctors suggested.

meaning: تنزل دادن؛ به مرتبه پایین‌تر فرستادن

examples.english: After the injury, the star player was relegated to the bench for the rest of the season.
examples.persian: پس از آسیب‌دیدگی، آن بازیکن ستاره برای باقی فصل به نیمکت ذخیره‌ها تنزل داده شد.

miniContext: After the injury, the star player was relegated to the bench for the rest of the season.

examples.english: It would be remiss of me not to mention how much help my team gave during the project.
examples.persian: سهل‌انگاری من خواهد بود اگر اشاره نکنم تیمم چقدر در طول این پروژه کمک کرد.

miniContext: It would be remiss of me not to mention how much help my team gave during the project.

examples.english: Stealing money from a charity is a truly reprehensible act.
examples.persian: دزدیدن پول از یک موسسه خیریه، کاری واقعاً شایسته سرزنش است.

miniContext: Stealing money from a charity is a truly reprehensible act.

examples.english: The old reprobate spent every evening at the tavern, ignoring his family's pleas.
examples.persian: آن فرد بی‌اخلاق و منحرف پیر، هر شب را در میخانه می‌گذراند و به خواهش‌های خانواده‌اش توجهی نمی‌کرد.

miniContext: The old reprobate spent every evening at the tavern, ignoring his family's pleas.

examples.english: The senator chose to publicly repudiate the rumors about his business dealings.
examples.persian: سناتور تصمیم گرفت علناً شایعات درباره معاملات تجاری‌اش را رد و انکار کند.

miniContext: The senator chose to publicly repudiate the rumors about his business dealings.

examples.english: The university decided to rescind its offer after discovering the student had lied on the application.
examples.persian: دانشگاه تصمیم گرفت پیشنهاد پذیرشش را لغو کند، پس از آنکه متوجه شد دانشجو در فرم درخواست دروغ گفته بود.

miniContext: The university decided to rescind its offer after discovering the student had lied on the application.

examples.english: He was reticent about his childhood and rarely mentioned his hometown.
examples.persian: او درباره دوران کودکی‌اش کم‌حرف و محتاط بود و به‌ندرت از شهر زادگاهش حرف می‌زد.

miniContext: He was reticent about his childhood and rarely mentioned his hometown.

examples.english: The visitors fell into a reverent silence as they entered the ancient temple.
examples.persian: بازدیدکنندگان هنگام ورود به معبد باستانی، در سکوتی احترام‌آمیز غرق شدند.

miniContext: The visitors fell into a reverent silence as they entered the ancient temple.

examples.english: When she asked, 'Do you ever listen to me?' it was clearly a rhetorical question.
examples.persian: وقتی او پرسید «آیا اصلاً به من گوش می‌دهی؟» واضح بود که این یک سوال بلاغی برای تاکید بود.

miniContext: When she asked, 'Do you ever listen to me?' it was clearly a rhetorical question.

examples.english: The sagacious old farmer predicted the drought months before anyone else noticed the signs.
examples.persian: کشاورز پیر و خردمند، خشکسالی را ماه‌ها پیش از آنکه دیگران نشانه‌ها را ببینند، پیش‌بینی کرد.

miniContext: The sagacious old farmer predicted the drought months before anyone else noticed the signs.

examples.english: The report's most salient point was that sales had dropped for six months straight.
examples.persian: برجسته‌ترین نکته گزارش این بود که فروش به مدت شش ماه متوالی کاهش یافته بود.

miniContext: The report's most salient point was that sales had dropped for six months straight.

examples.english: His sanctimonious lecture about honesty annoyed everyone who knew he had lied last week.
examples.persian: سخنرانی ریاکارانه و اخلاق‌مدار او درباره صداقت، همه کسانی را که می‌دانستند او هفته پیش دروغ گفته، آزار داد.

miniContext: His sanctimonious lecture about honesty annoyed everyone who knew he had lied last week.

examples.english: The accountant was scrupulous about recording every single receipt, no matter how small.
examples.persian: آن حسابدار در ثبت هر رسید، هرقدر هم کوچک، بسیار دقیق و وظیفه‌شناس بود.

miniContext: The accountant was scrupulous about recording every single receipt, no matter how small.

examples.english: The website was full of spurious claims about a miracle cure for every illness.
examples.persian: آن وب‌سایت پر از ادعاهای جعلی و ظاهراً معتبر درباره یک درمان معجزه‌آسا برای هر بیماری بود.

miniContext: The website was full of spurious claims about a miracle cure for every illness.

examples.english: The bank's staid lobby, with its gray walls and quiet clerks, rarely changed over the decades.
examples.persian: سالن آرام و رسمی بانک، با دیوارهای خاکستری و کارمندان ساکتش، در طول دهه‌ها به‌ندرت تغییر کرده بود.

miniContext: The bank's staid lobby, with its gray walls and quiet clerks, rarely changed over the decades.

examples.english: She remained a staunch supporter of the local theater even after it lost its funding.
examples.persian: او حتی پس از آنکه تئاتر محلی بودجه‌اش را از دست داد، همچنان حامی معتقد و وفادار آن باقی ماند.

miniContext: She remained a staunch supporter of the local theater even after it lost its funding.

examples.english: The new factory had to follow stringent safety rules before it could reopen.
examples.persian: کارخانه جدید پیش از بازگشایی مجبور بود از قوانین ایمنی سخت‌گیرانه پیروی کند.

miniContext: The new factory had to follow stringent safety rules before it could reopen.

examples.english: The empire sought to subjugate the smaller kingdoms along its border.
examples.persian: آن امپراتوری در پی آن بود که پادشاهی‌های کوچک‌تر در مرز خود را تحت سلطه درآورد.

miniContext: The empire sought to subjugate the smaller kingdoms along its border.

examples.english: The supercilious waiter rolled his eyes at every question the tourists asked.
examples.persian: گارسون متکبر و ازخودراضی به هر سوالی که گردشگران می‌پرسیدند، چشم‌غره می‌رفت.

miniContext: The supercilious waiter rolled his eyes at every question the tourists asked.

examples.english: She took a surreptitious glance at her phone during the long, boring meeting.
examples.persian: او در طول آن جلسه طولانی و خسته‌کننده، نگاهی مخفیانه به گوشی‌اش انداخت.

miniContext: She took a surreptitious glance at her phone during the long, boring meeting.

examples.english: The taciturn mechanic answered every question with a single word, if he answered at all.
examples.persian: آن مکانیک کم‌حرف به هر سوالی تنها با یک کلمه پاسخ می‌داد، اگر اصلاً پاسخ می‌داد.

miniContext: The taciturn mechanic answered every question with a single word, if he answered at all.

examples.english: Ignoring the warning signs was tantamount to inviting disaster.
examples.persian: نادیده گرفتن علائم هشداردهنده، هم‌ارز و معادل با دعوت فاجعه بود.

miniContext: Ignoring the warning signs was tantamount to inviting disaster.
